A surprise, and a pleasant one at that, was provided when a cheque for £1164 was presented to Treasurer Jim Heathfield by Geoff. Davis from the Trustees of the men's Section of Surrey A.C.following last years merger.
Geoff.Davis, in the year of his joint Presidency and coping with the marriage in the summer of his daughter, was actively involved in the organisation of officials and our home meetings.

Derek was elected President in 1981 and the following year served as joint President with Geoff Davis. In his final year of office he took the initiative in proposing and developing the re-organised Management Structure which has now come into operation.

After our great win at Windsor, the last round match was a Belgrave home promotion at Battersea and what a great day it was - Geoff Davis did an amazing job - we had more officials than in the Coliseum, L.A.
• Just because we don't see much of our Past President Geoff Davis now that he has retired to Peterborough it doesn't mean that that he is resting on his laurels.

We regret to report that long time athletics official Geoff Davis, Past President of Belgrave Harriers and Surrey AC, died on the morning of Tuesday 29 November at the age of 73 after a long period of illness.

I see from our report of 11 years ago, that on Monday evenings he used to make a round trip of 160 miles in order to compete in our veterans’ Track and Field League matches. Geoff Davis died on 29 November 2005. He was our President during 1982-83 when his old club Surrey AC amalgamated with Belgrave Harriers.
